sharedSchemaValidation.note: NodeCatalog is the shared numeric-policy owner; unchanged by this work, listed so the inventory is complete
descriptorRules: hard range: finite, minimum <= maximum, numeric only, integer bounds integral
soft range: finite, ordered, inside the hard range, numeric only
nonzero numeric only; step finite and > 0 and numeric only
displayDecimals 0..9; choices non-empty and unique for Choice only; editor ids namespaced
initialValue only for scalar Integer/Float; label/section/row free of control characters
capabilities: sampling scales from {1,2,4} unique; quality modes Draft/Full unique; channel names non-empty and unique
valueRules: type identity; finite and float-representable; nonzero; inside the declared hard range; declared choice membership
identityRules: hard range, nonzero, default, choices, creation-time initial value and implementationVersion are implementation identity (NodeContributions::schemaMismatch) - this is why the schema changes required merge 4->5, transform 2->3, roto 1->2 and grade/blur 2->3

shared: every effect declares the optional-mask contract (required image at port 0, optional mask at port 1); maskChannel is none/R/G/B/A and an absent mask is unlimited
mix is finite only (no range) and blends source + (effect - source) * mix; a connected mask contributes its clamped selected channel, optionally inverted
blur: size is a full-resolution support radius (>= 0); channels are RGBA/RGB/Alpha; the read demand is a halo of ceil(size/scale) samples with the mask read at output coordinates; geometry/raster admission unchanged
grade: Enabled-channel gamma is finite and positive; coefficients/exponents must be representable.
For unequal endpoints, Reverse requires a nonzero slope; forward Multiply=0 remains valid.
At exact equal endpoints, Forward applies remaining Grade math to the shared value; Reverse returns that endpoint without dividing by slope. Clamps then Mask/Mix apply normally.
crop: requires a connected image input and a known incoming format height
the authored box must stay inside the representable coordinate domain (|coord| <= kMaxDescribedCoordinate)
reformat requires a non-empty floor/ceil enclosure or it would publish a zero-pixel format
an empty intersection stays a valid fully transparent image
softness is a ramp width: non-negative in the schema and re-checked by cropNumber
merge: operation must be a declared mode; A and B are required inputs (B is the main input); described bounds union the two inputs
reformat: only the controls the selected type consumes are constrained (an unused authored value never rejects)
the resize policy derives the canvas from the source; filter must be a declared name; the filter sampling window must land inside the int index range
a composition target needs the owning network's authored canvas; the main input must describe a pixel grid; a non-positive placement scale is refused
roto: rotoInteger accepts only |value| <= 2^31-1; outputChannel must name a channel
maskChannel is an exact stored channel name with `none` reserved; a missing channel on a connected mask contributes zero coverage before optional inversion
clip is one of format/bbox/union/intersect/none; a generator uses the canvas for bbox/union
the matte extent must be representable (|coord| <= kMaxDescribedCoordinate): refused, never truncated
geometry admission: kMaxRotoVerticesPerContour, kMaxRotoVerticesPerSample, kMaxRotoItemsPerSample, kMaxRotoGeometryWords, kMaxRotoRasterScratchSamples (resource, not parameter bounds)
shuffle: input1/input2 are B or A; sourceKind rows are input1/input2/zero/one; an enabled B/A row must name a source channel; no two enabled rows may claim one output channel; a disabled row is unvalidated by design
source: rangeFirst <= rangeLast; the frame mapping multiply/add is checked for 64-bit overflow; frameStep nonzero; media binding failures name the source key
transform: scale nonzero finite with a finite reciprocal (negative is the same map mirrored and is now authored state)
the main-input pixel aspect must be finite and positive to bound the read; the inverse-mapped read must be representable
Mix != 1 or a connected mask retains inherited data bounds, including extrapolation; signed scale uses absolute filter padding.
translate/rotate are unbounded; +-200 / +-180 is soft travel
write: file type is exr/mov/mp4; EXR compression must be in the closed inventory; a MOV profile must be declared; colorspace/display color modes require an output transform; a LUT extension needs a registered reader; mp4 requires bitrate >= 1 kbps; a movie frame rate must be finite, > 0 and (at the writer) a positive 32-bit rational; a movie cannot carry an alpha-only channel selection; a still pattern cannot name a multi-frame range and a movie pattern cannot name a sequence
premult_unpremult: both channel choices must be declared members
none: viewer, output, testpattern and constcolor declare no numeric parameter at all (only subject to the shared schema rules)

reformatCanvasDomain.statement: reformat scaleX/scaleY are CANVAS DIMENSION multipliers (output = round(source * scale) in reformatOutputCanvas), not image transforms. A negative factor does not mirror: it drives the derived dimension below one pixel, which reformatRoundedDimension floors to the 1-pixel minimum - a silent 1x1 collapse. Mirroring is the separate flop/flip placement flags, which never change the canvas dimensions. So the retained rule is a representation constraint on a DERIVED PIXEL COUNT (finite, > 0, finite reciprocal), and it is the guard that keeps the floor from being reached. Transform's scale is different in kind: it is an affine factor of the inverse map where a negative value is a real mirror - hence its minimum was removed and Reformat's was not.
ownedDomains: derived canvas dimensions: finite, |v| <= kMaxDescribedCoordinate, never below 1 pixel, then re-checked 1..kMaxDescribedCoordinate
pixel aspect: finite and > 0 for authored and resolved canvas alike (requirePositiveAspect)
filter sampling window: first/last/base must land inside the int index range (reformatSampleWindow)
composition target without the owning canvas, and a main input with no pixel grid: node-identifying refusal
resolved placement scale (gx/gy) non-positive: node-identifying refusal

navigationPolicy.ParameterSlider: Navigation range includes authored out-of-travel values, is frozen during a drag, and handle drags apply relative deltas without snapping the source value.
navigationPolicy.customEditors: Crop softness navigation and Roto master opacity adapters read schema metadata; registered numeric cells no longer bind removed NumericField soft-bound properties.
navigationPolicy.hardBounds: Semantic/representation bounds remain authoritative; rejected edits preserve document/history and remain diagnosable through existing command/controller/evaluation owners.

inlineErrorPolicy.retained: Existing numeric error borders/tooltips/accessibility; component-unavailable host states; explicit Write job feedback. No new notification surface.
inlineErrorPolicy.diagnostics: Read syntax errors use the existing shared rejectText/field affordance. Shuffle duplicate output rejection reaches authoritative effectiveShuffle, not a parallel QML validator.
